developer.title: Developer mode
developer.description: Tools imported from the Expo flow and adapted to the current web/mobile shell.
developer.quickAccessDescription: Shows quick sign-in buttons and test shortcuts on authentication screens.
developer.formBlocksDescription: Keeps the behavior that blocks steps when the flow has validation issues.
developer.zodValidationDescription: Turns schema validation on or off for the sample form flow.
developer.mockedDataDescription: Marks the interface as powered by local sample data for layout and navigation tests.
developer.ignoreTlsDescription: Keeps insecure-environment behavior reserved for local and staging scenarios.
developer.webShell: Web shell active: classic header, wide content and footer.
developer.mobileShell: Mobile shell active: contextual top bar, compact content and an easy-reach bottom bar.
developer.captchaDisabledDescription: Removes the anti-bot check (Turnstile) from sign in and "forgot password" on web. Development environment only.
developer.appUpdateNone: No new update on npm run dev.
developer.appUpdateFailed: Failed: check that the phone reaches npm run dev (app log).

system.title: Layout structure panel
system.description: Global physical-grid configuration panel for validating the SystemContext in real time.
system.disabledFallback: System panel disabled. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SYSTEM_PANEL_ENABLED=true in .env to enable it.
system.liveNotice: Changes made here are local and in-memory. The default fallback stays disabled when the public flag is missing or false.
system.headerVisibleDescription: Keeps the top structural region mounted in the grid.
system.leftSidebarVisibleDescription: Keeps the left structural region mounted in the grid.
system.rightSidebarVisibleDescription: Keeps the right structural region mounted in the grid.
system.footerVisibleDescription: Keeps the bottom structural region mounted in the grid.
system.headerHeightDescription: Structural height in pixels for the top region.
system.footerHeightDescription: Structural height in pixels for the bottom region.
system.leftSidebarWidthDescription: Structural width in pixels for the left region.
system.rightSidebarWidthDescription: Structural width in pixels for the right region.
system.mainContentCardMarginDescription: Structural margin in pixels applied to the MainContent card when Card mode is active.
system.zIndexHeaderDescription: Structural stacking order for the top region.
system.zIndexFooterDescription: Structural stacking order for the bottom region.
system.mainContentModeDescription: Structural base mode for the main content region.

login.helper: Use any valid email and a password with at least 6 characters.
